description: Bulk-delete finished execution records by filter (status, workflow, older than N days) to reclaim database space. Runs as a dry run by default — set dryRun=false to actually delete. Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. Running/waiting executions are never touched.

dryRun.description: Preview what would be deleted without deleting

olderThanDays.description: Only prune executions that stopped more than N days ago

status.description: Only prune executions with this terminal status

workflowId.description: Only prune executions of this workflow

name: prune_executions
